How to read it
Centre glyph: the species, drawn the same on its pods, its Library page and every member's ring.
Grey inner band: the species frame: 57 locked parts (62 marks). Identical for every member; known once the species is identified.
Two coloured tracks: the 57 heritable parts, one spoke each: inner track = one copy (from the mother, or the pod's first), outer = the other copy (father).
Long / short bar: which look that copy holds; a part with three or more looks takes two to four spokes.
Colour: the chapter: Coat, Face, Shape, Legs & tail, Movement, Stamina, Temperament, clockwise from the notch. Paper prints it in black.
Hairline: a chapter not read yet: unknown, never guessed. Reading a chapter turns its hairlines into bars.
Outer dashes and notch: orientation, species number, code version and a check, so a scanner knows which layout to read and can reject a mis-scan.
Copies drawn independently per locus from each species' pool, seed 20261007; the child takes one real copy from each parent. Script kept outside the repository.
